sentences.text: The animal lives in the forest.
Fish is sold at the market.
A bird sits on the tree.
The dog plays with the child.
There is a louse in the hair.
A snake hid in the grass.
Worms came out after the rain.
A tree has grown in the yard.
The farmer went to the forest.
A stick fell from the tree.
A seed sprouts in the soil.
A leaf fell from the tree.
The farmer pulled up a root.
The boy lay on the grass.
There is fat on the meat.
A feather blew in the wind.
The child picked up a feather.
The hat is on the head.
The sole of the foot hurts.
Sand is on the sole of the foot.
The child cleaned the sole of his foot.
